profile: Xenon Pharmaceuticals is a neuroscience biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for neurological and psychiatric disorders. Its lead candidate azetukalner, a Kv7 potassium channel opener, has an NDA submitted to the FDA for focal seizures and is in Phase 3 studies for epilepsy. The company completed enrollment in a Phase 3 major depressive disorder study and continues to develop earlier-stage ion-channel programs for pain and other conditions.
